events.what_it_is: A three-day immersive TEMPTATIONS pop-up celebrating NYC bodega cats, with a cat-themed bodega environment, games, photo moments and product sampling.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples, plus chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise through games and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: The TEMPTATIONS/Mars press release states 213 Bowery and 12–6 PM daily September 17–19. One secondary roundup lists 216 Bowery, but multiple other current sources and the brand release use 213 Bowery, so 213 is used here. Free treats and merchandise prizes are subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Thursday–Saturday, September 17–19, 12–6 PM daily. Open to the public; no advance RSVP requirement is published in the brand announcement.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product discovery, samples, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary VEFB+ sample, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissant and scratch-off giveaway while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The current Eventbrite listing is organized by Bobbi Brown Cosmetics and advertises the September 17 activation from 12–6 PM. Giveaways and refreshments are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured for Bobbi Brown social and digital channels, and attendees may appear in that content.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Use the Bobbi Brown organizer Eventbrite listing for the free registration path. Arrive early if the deluxe sample is the priority because only the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive it.

events.event_name: CookUnity: The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis, where eight chefs serve CookUnity dishes from neighborhood counters.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made CookUnity meals and hot bites while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off for chances to win CookUnity meals for a year or restaurant experiences.
events.caveats: Current sources consistently describe this as open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement. Meals are explicitly while supplies last, so availability can end before 2:30 PM. This is one simultaneous event across five locations rather than five separately timed programs.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Participating locations: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave. Arrive early because food is while supplies last.
